_comment: sc-18808 standalone capture plan for the first VIDEO calibration lane, mlx:ltx_2_3. It is deliberately NOT in config/memory-calibration-plan.json: generate-memory-matrix.mjs resolves its coordinate universe from manifest.models.filter(m => m.type === "image"), so a video plan entry matches no coordinate and assertCalibrationPlanTargetsResolvedCoordinates fails the check gate closed. Moving this row into the shipped plan is sc-18817's job, once sc-18815 has made the matrix modality-aware. Drive it with: node scripts/memory-calibration-harness.mjs run --config docs/calibration/sc-18808/ltx-mlx-video-capture-plan.json --backend mlx --fresh-per-case --provider-command '["<target>/release/memory-mlx-adapter"]' --sceneworks-repo <repo> --inference-repo <inference-at-pin> --output <outside-the-repo>.json
